title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after 33 years
title_zh: 执掌33年后，黄仁勋突然辞去英伟达CEO

image.credit: Photo by Campaign Creators on Unsplash
image.author: Campaign Creators

lead: Jensen Huang, who built Nvidia into the backbone of the global AI computing market, has stepped down as chief executive with immediate effect. Chief financial officer Colette Kress takes over on an interim basis while the board searches for a permanent successor.
lead_zh: 把英伟达做成全球AI算力市场核心的黄仁勋，已即刻辞去首席执行官一职。首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯暂时接任，董事会则开始物色正式接班人。

preview_zh: 英伟达11月12日宣布，黄仁勋已辞去首席执行官、总裁及董事职务，即刻生效。此前一周风波不断：11月8日董事会启动独立调查并聘请外部律师，同时坚称没有理由认为美国国家安全或公司商业秘密受到损害，并表示仍信任黄仁勋及其团队。但短短几天内，这份信任显然已经崩塌。
paragraphs: Nvidia announced on November 12 that Huang had resigned as CEO, president and board director, effective immediately. The departure follows a turbulent week: on November 8 the board opened an independent investigation, retaining outside counsel, while insisting it had no reason to believe US national security or company trade secrets had been compromised and that it retained confidence in Huang and his team. Within days, that confidence had evidently collapsed.

Reuters reported on November 11 that directors were weighing whether to remove Huang; a day later the company confirmed the change. Nvidia did not specify why he left, nor publish the investigation's conclusions. His exit is all the more striking because he shaped virtually every strategic pivot of the past three decades, from GeForce graphics cards and the CUDA software ecosystem to today's AI accelerators and data-centre business.

Kress, 59, joined Nvidia in 2013 after stints at Microsoft, Cisco and Texas Instruments, and is a familiar figure to investors from quarterly earnings calls. Ian Buck, who arrived in 2004 and helped build CUDA, now oversees AI hardware and software for hyperscale data centres and is seen as a strong internal contender. External names reportedly under discussion include Apple's Johny Srouji, Arm's Rene Haas and Google Cloud's Thomas Kurian.

On Polymarket, Kress leads the successor market at an implied 32%, with Buck close behind on 28%. Investors reacted sharply: shares fell 12.51% in pre-market trading to $152.00 from $173.73, after roughly $600bn of market value had already been wiped out during the week. Nvidia reports quarterly results on November 17, when attention will fall equally on AI chip demand and on who will set its technical direction.

Nvidia still holds a formidable product line-up, a mature CUDA ecosystem and a customer network spanning the world's largest technology firms — advantages that will not vanish overnight. The real test is whether the next chief executive can keep making the right technical and commercial calls in a fast-shifting AI market.
paragraphs_zh: 英伟达11月12日宣布，黄仁勋已辞去首席执行官、总裁及董事职务，即刻生效。此前一周风波不断：11月8日董事会启动独立调查并聘请外部律师，同时坚称没有理由认为美国国家安全或公司商业秘密受到损害，并表示仍信任黄仁勋及其团队。但短短几天内，这份信任显然已经崩塌。
路透社11月11日报道称，董事们正在讨论是否解除黄仁勋的职务；一天后公司便证实了这一变动。英伟达没有说明他离职的具体原因，也未公布调查结论。他的离开格外引人注目，因为过去三十年里公司几乎每一次战略转型都由他主导——从GeForce显卡、CUDA软件生态，到如今的AI加速器和数据中心业务。
现年59岁的克雷斯2013年加入英伟达，此前曾在微软、思科和德州仪器任职，常出现在季度财报电话会上，为投资者所熟悉。2004年入职、参与打造CUDA的伊恩·巴克目前负责面向超大规模数据中心的AI软硬件，被视为有力的内部人选。据报外部讨论的人选还包括苹果的Johny Srouji、Arm的Rene Haas和谷歌云的托马斯·库里安。
在Polymarket的继任者预测市场上，克雷斯以32%的隐含概率领先，巴克以28%紧随其后。投资者反应剧烈：股价盘前下跌12.51%，从173.73美元跌至152.00美元，而当周市值已累计蒸发约6000亿美元。英伟达将于11月17日发布季度财报，届时外界既关注AI芯片需求，也同样关注谁来制定公司的技术路线。
英伟达仍拥有强大的产品阵容、成熟的CUDA生态以及覆盖全球科技巨头的客户网络，这些优势不会一夜消失。真正的考验在于，下一任首席执行官能否在快速变化的AI市场中继续做出正确的技术与商业决策。33年来第一次，这家公司要在没有他的情况下决定自己的未来。
